title: An Act Regarding Retirement Benefits and Salary Adjustments for Judicial Employees

summary.text: This bill allows an employee of the judicial branch to retire before reaching 65 years of age if the employee retires upon completion of 35 years of continuous creditable service. The bill also requires the State to pay 100% of the health insurance premium for that retiree until the retiree reaches 65 years of age or otherwise qualifies for Medicare. The bill directs the Department of Administrative and Financial Services to calculate any savings in salary and other associated costs due to the retirement of judicial employees and to use those savings to increase salaries of employees of the judicial branch.
